verdict.rationale: Square's Locations API confirms merchants can create and manage multiple locations, each with its own settings (e.g., custom receipt text) editable via the Dashboard or API, and location data can be retrieved/updated per-location. However, there's no explicit evidence of per-location device fleet management or per-location reporting dashboards beyond the basic Locations API. missing for 10: dedicated per-location device provisioning/management docs, per-location reporting/analytics evidence.
